_doc: What every film must have before it is rendered (film_check.py <work> <films...>) and what the out folder must hold after (film_check.py <work> --out <out>). Each item: id, fmt (long | short | out), metric (a function in film_check.py), op (>= | <= | == | true), value, why (Kamil's words or a measured reference). A plan may skip an item only with a reason: "skip": {"<id>": "why not in this film"}. Thresholds are data: change them here, not in code. Reference numbers: render/ref/research/teardowns.md (Jeff Su, Ali Abdaal, Kuba Klawiter, Fireship, 2026-11-04).

items.why: Producer role: story.json names the parts of the film and the word where each starts (Kamil 4.11: chapters entered where the part begins)
Kamil 4.11: 'nie podzieliłeś na chaptery treści z wejściem na ekranie', 'pomysł 3 ma wejście a reszta nie'; a chap card within 3 s of each part start
Kamil 4.11: 'najbardziej mi zależy na graficznym animowanym pokazywaniu moich pomysłów'; each part has a scene, float, slide or web card
One animated explanation every 2 minutes at least (AI LABS reference: a new picture every few seconds)
Film 1: 3.8/min, film 2: 1.5/min ('w ciul pominąłeś'); references 12-16/min
Seconds without a card, punch-in or b-roll; film 2 had 166 s
Kamil 4.11: 'na początku filmu jest zbyt mało bajerów'; references: about 14 cuts and many overlays in the first minute
Kamil 4.11: 'pominąłeś np. zoomy'; references about 3 punch-ins a minute
Kamil 4.11: 'nie ma napisów za plecami' (behind.py, ADR-0005)
Kamil 4.11: 'miały być też memy, memów nie ma'; the meme card existed since 10-31 and no film used it (film 2 v2: 9 in the long)
Kamil 4.11: title = Polish 'AI Automation & Implementation Engineer' (style/brand.json)
Kamil 4.11: 'co filmik nowa muzyczka'; palette and key differ from the last film (render/music_ledger.json)
The music follows the parts (RESEARCH lessons 7: music_moods)
Sounds by motion type (RESEARCH lessons 6)
End card with what to watch next
ZASADY-KAMILA-SHORTY: the hook stands on screen from the first second
Film 2 s2: hook at 4.3 s; the first picture change within a second
Caption pop-in from the reference shorts (main #6), not used in film 2
Kamil 4.11: 'pod shorty zero nowych logik': split, corner, web or meme cards
Kamil 4.11: 'miały być też memy'; a short whose scenes leave no face gap of 3 s skips it with that reason
References change the picture every 2.5-5 s; film 2 shorts stood 21-30 s on the face
Zoom on the key words
Own music, not the default bed
The long film in out/
Kamil 4.11: 'nie wiem czy nie jesteś leniwy z ilością shortów': every clip in clips.json with "make": true is rendered
Kamil 4.11: 'nie widzę plików z tytułami opisami per platforma': youtube/long.md with titles A/B/C, description, chapters from 0:00, tags; one file per short
Kamil 4.11: 'miałeś mi zawsze robić a/b thumbnaile': at least 2 for the long, a cover per short
Kamil 4.11: posts with graphics ready to upload: every post in posts.json with "make": true has a folder with text and a graphic
